concerns.text: T006 states 'no arbitrary ≥10 % significance threshold decides meaningfulness … the reduction percentage is reported, not gated.' Constitution VII is not arbitrary reviewer feedback: 'Models claiming improved predictive value (≥10% lower MAPE) via stress-mediated features MUST demonstrate this improvement consistently across the held-out test set and via paired t-tests on absolute errors.' A task that removes the constitutional ≥10% demonstration bar and demotes the paired t-test to 'supplementary' weakens a NON-NEGOTIABLE-adjacent project constraint. Either restore the constitutional gate for any claim of improved predictive value, or amend the constitution — a task cannot silently override it.

FR-001 mandates ingesting data from NIST, UCI, and OpenML repositories. No task fetches external data; T002 loads only the two bundled files and defers the gap to T013, which is a spec-revision task, not a data-acquisition task. T013's FR-001 amendment records the gap but the ingestion requirement still has no delivering task — the tasks list narrows FR-001 to 'bundled files only' without a spec clause that authorizes that as the delivered scope (the amendment documents a limitation; it does not re-scope the MUST).

FR-006/FR-007 are unconditional MUSTs ('execute bootstrap mediation analysis with 10,000 resamples on the subset where residual stress is measured'). T008/T009 gate mediation on a real open dataset that no task ever acquires, so the requirements are structurally reduced to 'always skipped'. T013 amends only FR-003 and FR-001 — it does not amend FR-006/FR-007 to authorize the conditional-skip semantics, so the tasks silently narrow two MUST requirements.

Spec FR-003 still mandates the linear proxy σ_res ≈ k·heat_input·cooling_rate while T002/T004 implement the non-linear form. The deviation is documented (plan Spec Deviation Flag) and T013 amends the spec, so this is staged rather than silent — but the tasks execute the deviation before the spec change lands; T013 should be ordered before or with T002, or the spec amendment should be noted as a precondition, to avoid an implementer following spec.md verbatim building the wrong formula.
